Optional spin-history intensity repair

Source: R/repair_spin_history.R
repair_spin_history.Rd

Optional spin-history intensity repair

Usage

repair_spin_history(
  x,
  motion,
  mask = NULL,
  method = c("slice_gain"),
  z_threshold = 3,
  smooth_window = 5L
)

Arguments

x

Corrected 4D image-like input.

motion

Motion matrix (nt x 6).

mask

Optional 3D logical mask.

method

Repair method.

z_threshold

Robust z-threshold for residual spike detection.

smooth_window

Odd integer smoothing window for temporal gain smoothing.

Value

A list with corrected output, gain map, and detection metadata.
